summary: This directory provides utilities for binary data manipulation and verification. It serves as a centralized location for low-level operations on binary formats, ensuring consistent handling and validation of binary structures across the application.
responsibilities: Providing standard operations for binary data
Ensuring consistency in binary format processing
Validating binary structures through automated testing
relationships: Binary operations utilize validation logic to ensure data integrity.
Automated tests verify that binary operations adhere to expected structural definitions.

Standardized interface for binary data handling
